Title: Users' Microsoft 365 Apps usage reports may show outdated data in the admin center

User impact: Users' Microsoft 365 Apps usage reports may show outdated data in the admin center.

Current status: We've identified through our monitoring of service health telemetry that an upstream component of the Microsoft 365 Apps usage data processing pipeline is in an unhealthy state, which is resulting in data reporting delays. We're working to implement a fix for the impacted component to restore timely data processing.

Scope of impact: This issue may impact any admin who is attempting to view Microsoft 365 Apps usage reports in the admin center. This information may be updated as our investigation continues.

Start time: Friday, October 30, 2026, at 12:00 AM UTC

Root cause: An upstream component of the data processing pipeline has entered an unhealthy state, resulting in delays processing Microsoft 365 Apps data.

Next update by: Saturday, October 31, 2026, at 2:00 AM UTC
